_comment: Golden accrual vectors. amount = floor(payment_amount × asset_usd_price × cashback / utl_usd_rate),
normalised to 18 decimals, expressed in UTL wei as a decimal integer string.
BE-09 (accrual) and BE-13 (issuer attestation) must both reproduce every row here,
byte for byte. An issuer that computes a different amount signs a different digest,
and no signature reaches the threshold — so a mismatch is a real bug, never a reason
Asset precision is the asset's own: 6 for USD₮ and XAUT, 8 for BTC. The payment amount
is truncated to that precision before anything else happens, and the single division at
the end is the only rounding step. floor everywhere — never round up into a mint.

vectors.note: the live sepolia demo payment: 0.01 USD₮ at the frozen Bitfinex price
USD₮ at exactly 1.0 — 5 % of 0.01 is 0.0005 UTL
below one wei of entitlement: floor takes it to zero rather than up to one
dust: a real but tiny entitlement survives as a single wei
sub-precision payment truncates to zero at USD₮'s 6 decimals
BTC sub-satoshi input truncates before it can be paid for
a UTL rate other than $1 divides, and still floors
whole-number payment, no fractional part at all
10 ETH at $1920.55 — an 18-decimal asset needs no re-scaling
1 wei of ETH is far below one wei of UTL entitlement
